name: iw4x86
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (IW4, the original 32-bit build)
note: The original 32-bit MW2 (zones IWffu100 / IWff0100 v276: the same 21-byte header as the 2026 rebuild, 32-bit content). Exe: the Steam iw4mp.exe (2023-07-31 build, x86, not encrypted: .text entropy 6.66), flattened (file offset == RVA); its loaders read the single-player zones too (same asset types; col_map_sp and game_map_sp have loaders). iw4sp.exe (2010) is not used: Steam CEG left parts of its .rdata zeroed (the asset name table's strings among them).
rva_note: read off iw4mp.exe: DB_LoadXFileData 0x4e0ba0 (dst, size, 0 on the stack) is called by Load_Stream 0x4f4de0 (flag, dst, size: block 2, runtime, memsets; every other block reads; then DB_IncStreamPos 0x4f4d60) and by Load_XString 0x4f4e90 (char**: one byte at a time); DB_PushStreamPos 0x4f4cc0 (block) and DB_PopStreamPos 0x4f4d00 (a pop into block 0 rewinds it) both through DB_SetStreamIndex 0x4f4c40 (edi; blocks 6 and 7 copied to their GPU buffers); DB_AllocStreamPos 0x4f4d40 (alignment - 1); DB_InitStreams 0x4f4b90 (the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); DB_InsertPointer 0x4f4d70 pushes 3, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops; DB_ConvertOffsetToPointer 0x4f4e60 and DB_ConvertOffsetToAlias 0x4f4e30 (dereferenced): block = (v - 1) >> 28, offset = (v - 1) & 0xfffffff

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset 0x4ef5c0 (flag): Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 8), varXAssetHeader (0x11a2048) = varXAsset + 4, then Load_XAssetHeader 0x4ef2a0 compares the type and tail-jumps to the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set

stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording (96 zones): blocks 3 (virtual, 2 559 185 reads), 6 (vertex, 113 113) and 7 (index, 82 978) only grow; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (373 121 of 373 568 reads below its previous end); 1, 4 and 5 hold nothing

zone_load.note: DB_LoadXFile's tail (0x4e073d): DB_InitStreams; 0x4e03f0 reads the 16-byte XAssetList raw into its static 0x11219c4 (varXAssetList 0x11a207c) and its script strings under push(3) (Load_ScriptStringList 0x4e0e80); push(3); when `assets != 0` the array aligned 4 (0x4e70f0) and Load_XAssetArray 0x4e0430 (eax = count): Load_Stream(1, list, count x 8), each entry through Load_XAsset(0) with varXAsset = &entry; pop

release.note: 2026-11-13: the emulator consumes 96/96 zones to their last byte and the tables read them identically (emuwalk); all 96 recorded; measure 86/86 under its 256 MB cap, the 10 above compared by blocks native (C++ layout == recording, 96/96 zones, 2 755 276 reads); gate 4: fe63f0 (GfxWorld's aabb tree pointers, counted through two marks of its parent) is inexact on 4 of 687 272 occurrences replayed out of context, its zones identical
